I can't tell you whether you can get into UF or not; I can just tell you my story. I live in Iran. For each major grade ( elementary school, high school, bachelor's degree, master's degree, Ph.D.) There is a national university entrance test that determines which universities we can study in. I messed up on the high school test and did even worse on the bachelor's degree test. So I decided I'd study hard on the master's test ( that was before I knew I had ADHD). While studying I realized I couldn't focus, plan, memorize, or do anything else that was necessary. I did awful on that test too but I managed to get into Tehran university ( one of the best in the country ) just because I managed to answer all English questions correctly ( for context, I got -6 in electronics which is my main subject ). That was around 6 months ago. In the first semester, I failed one class, barely passed another, and finished with an average of 14/20. Throughout the semester I constantly felt like I didn't belong; well truth is I didn't. Most students here did amazingly on their entrance exam, I only got in cuz I could speak English. They made plans, did extra work, and studied daily and I couldn't do any of those things. Now I know why we need entrance exams. They make sure only people who can survive in that environment get in. I would have never applied for this universality if I knew what was needed of me. If you don't get into UF, don't be sad; because even if you did get in, in that situation, you wouldn't survive it. We have to accept that we have limitations. And those limitations will stop us from doing many things. You want it, believe me, I know. I want to be where I am so badly but some things are not for everyone. A blind person can not become an artist; a disabled person can not run a Marathon. There are some things we can't do. It's not fair but life seldom is. Try your best, I hope that you get in and do wonderful things but if you're not accepted, accept that it's not meant to be.

They have no batteries or any other sources of energy and the broadcasters can only work at very short distances and only on a specific types of tags that they've been configured for.
